All inclusive resorts have become increasingly popular in Cancun, offering guests the convenience of paying one price for accommodation, food, drinks, and activities. Most of these resorts come with multiple restaurants, bars, lounges, entertainment, pools, activities and a spa. All you have to do is check in and enjoy. With so many Cancun all inclusive resort options available, choosing the best resort for your needs can be challenging. In this guide, we’ll look at several of the top-rated resorts in Cancun and their location, amenities, dining options, and more. We will also list family friendly all inclusive resorts and adults only resorts.

This article contains affiliate links. If you click on our links, we may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. This helps us continue to offer free travel guides, but does not influence our recommendations in any way. Thanks for supporting independent travel content.

Where to Stay in Cancun

The Top Neighborhoods

+ click map to enlarge

THE HOTEL ZONE

The Hotel Zone (Zona Hotelera) is the primary tourist area in Cancun. It’s located on a narrow strip of land that separates the Caribbean Sea from the Nichupte Lagoon. Here, visitors will find an array of beachfront resorts, high quality restaurants, nightlife venues and upscale shopping malls. Many of the Cancun all inclusive resorts listed below are in the Hotel Zone. The Hotel Zone is also home to some of Cancun’s most famous beaches, including Playa Delfines and Playa Tortugas. With its beautiful beaches, and lively nightlife scene, the Hotel Zone is the perfect destination for travelers seeking a fun and indulgent vacation experience.

PLAYA MUJERES

Playa Mujeres is a tranquil and upscale neighborhood located north of Cancun. It’s most known for its stunning beaches and luxury resorts. This newly developed area boasts a more laid-back atmosphere compared to the bustling Hotel Zone. This makes it an ideal destination for couples and families looking for a quieter vacation. Visitors can enjoy a range of outdoor activities, such as golfing, fishing, and snorkeling. High-end amenities like spas, fine dining, and boutique shopping are also available. Playa Mujeres is a good spot for boat trips to nearby Isla Mujeres.

RIVIERA CANCUN

Riviera Cancun is a newer and exclusive area located south of Cancun’s Hotel Zone. It is known for its serene atmosphere, luxury amenities, and world-class golf courses. The area features a stunning coastline and is home to some of the most high end resorts in the region. Riviera Cancun offers top-notch dining options, spa treatments, and many other activities as well. With its secluded atmosphere and high-end amenities, Riviera Cancun is an ideal destination for couples and families seeking a more upscale vacation experience.

CENTRO

The Centro neighborhood is also known as Downtown Cancun. Centro is the heart of the city and is known for its vibrant street markets, local shops, and authentic cuisine. There are no all inclusive resorts in Centro, but there are many great Cancun hotels.

New Resort Openings & Major Renovations

2026 Cancun Resort Update

Cancun’s hotel scene is booming with new all-inclusive properties and big upgrades to beloved resorts. Here are some of the most noteworthy developments in 2024 and 2025:

  • Ocean Allure Costa Mujeres (Opened Dec 2025) – The flagship of the rebranded Ocean Signature Resorts offers 599 adults-only suites in Costa Mujeres. A wave pool, lazy river, and rooftop infinity pool headline the water features. Contemporary design and multiple specialty restaurants complete the package. Check Prices
  • Majestic Mirage Costa Mujeres (Opened Dec 2025) – This all-suite resort sets a new luxury standard with entry-level suites exceeding 1,000 square feet and butler service for all guests. Twelve pools, both family and adults-only sections, and exceptional dining make this Costa Mujeres standout worth the splurge. Check Prices
  • Secrets Mirabel Cancun Resort & Spa (Opened Nov 2025) – This 487-suite adults-only retreat brings Hyatt’s Unlimited-Luxury concept to the Hotel Zone at Km 19.5. Eight restaurants, six bars, and a Mayan-inspired spa create a sophisticated escape between the Caribbean Sea and Nichupté Lagoon. Perfect for couples seeking upscale relaxation. Check Prices
  • Excellence Coral Playa Mujeres (Opened Feb 2025) – Excellence Group’s newest adults-only addition features 450 suites, each with private terrace hot tubs. Ten restaurants, an expansive spa, and the brand’s signature high staff-to-guest ratio deliver the personalized service Excellence is known for. Check Prices
  • Hyatt Vivid Grand Island (Opened April 2024) – A brand-new adults-only, all-inclusive resort featuring 400 suites. Hyatt Vivid offers a “down-to-earth” yet upscale vibe with 10+ dining venues, six bars, three pools, and even a private beach club. This resort opened on a newly developed island area in the Hotel Zone and targets younger adults with a lively but laid-back atmosphere. Check Prices
  • Secrets Playa Blanca Costa Mujeres (Opened Feb 2024) – A luxury adults-only escape on the tranquil Isla Blanca peninsula (north of downtown Cancun). This 507-room beachfront resort debuted in early 2024 with expansive pools, a world-class Secrets Spa, and a wide array of gourmet restaurants and bars. It caters to couples seeking a quiet, upscale retreat in the emerging Costa Mujeres area. Check Prices
  • Hotel Mousai Cancun (Opened May 2024) – An ultra-chic adults-only resort by TAFER Hotels, located oceanfront in Costa Mujeres. Opened in spring 2024, it offers all-suite accommodations with contemporary art-inspired décor and lavish amenities. Guests enjoy panoramic rooftop pools and high-end dining – Hotel Mousai is quickly making a name as a luxury boutique all-inclusive option in greater Cancun. Check Prices
  • Marriott Cancun, An All-Inclusive Resort (Reopened March 2024) – The former Marriott Cancun (next to the JW Marriott) underwent an extensive $40 million renovation and re-launched as a fully all-inclusive resort. The beachfront property now boasts completely renovated rooms and suites, nine dining venues, multiple pools, a new water park for families, and daily entertainment programs. This marks Marriott’s first all-inclusive in Cancun’s Hotel Zone and brings a familiar brand into the mix. Check Prices
  • SLS Playa Mujeres (Opened Nov 2024) – The SLS hotel brand expanded to Cancun with a new all-inclusive in Playa Mujeres in late 2024. This beachfront property offers a boutique vibe (only ~45 rooms) with stylish design by Philippe Starck, four pools, a high-end spa, and curated gourmet dining. It targets trendsetters and even made Travel + Leisure’s “It List” 2023 for its blend of luxury and fun. Check Prices
  • Melia Casa Maya Cancun (Reopened Dec 2024) – The long-running Casa Maya resort re-emerged under the Melia brand after a top-to-bottom renovation. Now a 5-star all-inclusive, it features modernized rooms (including premium “Level” suites with VIP perks) and new family facilities. A highlight is the “Splash Island” water park with slides and spray zones for kids, making the new Melia Casa Maya a compelling option for families. Check Prices

Looking Ahead: 2026 and Beyond – Even more high-end development is on the horizon. The Park Hyatt Cancun is slated to open later in 2026, promising sophisticated luxury on a prime beachfront site. Other ultra-luxe brands are following: a St. Regis Costa Mujeres (with the brand’s famed butler service) is in the works for 2026, and additional projects in Costa Mujeres and the Riviera Maya continue to solidify the region as a luxury hotspot. In short, Cancun’s all-inclusive landscape is continuously evolving with new resorts and upgrades each year.

1. Grand Fiesta Americana Coral Beach

Resort Overview

Grand Fiesta Americana Coral Beach is a luxurious, all-suite resort situated on a pristine beachfront in Cancun’s hotel zone. Renowned for exceptional service and elegance, the resort features a striking marble lobby, upscale decor, and a sophisticated atmosphere suitable for families, couples, and groups alike. The property boasts prestigious accolades, including AAA Five Diamond recognition. Guests enjoy extensive amenities, from lagoon-style pools to engaging kids’ facilities, world-class dining, and an acclaimed spa. For an elevated experience, the Infinite Club upgrade offers exclusive perks like private lounge access, premium services, VIP beach club entry, personalized concierge assistance, and priority check-in. The resort also does a great job of raking the sand to clear the seaweed, and the water here is very calm and good for swimming.

Show Full Review

Rooms

The resort features over 600 spacious, elegant suites, each with stunning ocean views from private balconies or terraces. Interiors boast marble flooring, luxurious bedding, well-stocked minibars, and expansive bathrooms, many with soaking tubs. Room options range from Junior Suites to spacious Master Suites and two-bedroom family accommodations. Guests consistently praise rooms for their cleanliness, comfort, and magnificent ocean vistas. Modern amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, 24-hour room service, and smart TVs. Infinite Club suites further enhance luxury with guaranteed oceanfront views from higher floors, nightly turndown service, and access to a private lounge featuring gourmet treats and premium beverages.

Amenities

Amenities cater to all ages, highlighted by a sprawling multi-tiered lagoon pool complex with waterfalls, hot tubs, and two swim-up bars. Families appreciate Coral KidZ Club, a 40,000 sq ft interactive children’s paradise featuring themed play zones and a splash park. Adults indulge at the Gem Spa, renowned for its luxurious 10-step hydrotherapy ritual and extensive treatment menu. Additional amenities include a modern fitness center, daily activities, and nightly entertainment ranging from live music to cultural performances. Infinite Club guests gain exclusive privileges like adults-only beach club access, complimentary hydrotherapy sessions, babysitting services, and complimentary ferry trips to Isla Mujeres.

Dining

Grand Fiesta Americana Coral Beach boasts nine diverse restaurants, ensuring exceptional culinary experiences. Viña del Mar presents lavish international buffets and champagne brunches, Isla Contoy specializes in fresh seafood, and Le Basilic offers sophisticated French-Mediterranean fine dining. La Joya delights guests with authentic Mexican cuisine, tequila tastings, and live mariachi music. Additional options include Chianti (Italian), Torii (Asian fusion), and Havanna Club (Argentine steakhouse). Several casual eateries, poolside snack bars, and multiple bars—including swim-up pool bars and a chic lobby lounge—provide ample dining variety. Infinite Club guests receive premium beverage selections, priority restaurant reservations, and exclusive lounge access.

Details

  • Who This Resort Is Perfect For: Families, couples, and groups seeking luxurious accommodations, family-friendly amenities, and premium all-inclusive services at a beachfront resort.
  • Tripadvisor Rating: 4.5 out of 5 stars, frequently praised for exceptional amenities, elegant atmosphere, and superior guest service.
  • Unique Amenities: 43,000 sq ft Gem Spa, high-tech Coral KidZ Club, and Infinite Club with private lounge and exclusive beach area.
  • Swimming Pools: Expansive multi-tier lagoon-style pool complex with waterfalls, hot tubs, swim-up bars, plus exclusive Infinite Club pool.
  • Beach Access: Direct beachfront with calm, crystal-clear waters protected from waves and seaweed by offshore reefs.
  • Can’t Miss For Grown Ups: Gem Spa’s hydrotherapy ritual and a gourmet dinner experience at the award-winning restaurant Le Basilic.
  • Can’t Miss For Kids: Coral KidZ Club featuring themed play areas, interactive technology, splash zones, and supervised daily activities.
  • How Many Restaurants and Bars?: Nine restaurants and multiple bars, ranging from gourmet specialty dining to casual eateries and swim-up pool bars.
  • Are Restaurant Reservations Required?: Yes, reservations are recommended for specialty à la carte restaurants during dinner hours.
  • Gratuities Included: Yes, gratuities and taxes are fully included in the all-inclusive package; additional tipping is optional.
  • Distance To Airport: Approximately 30 minutes (12 miles) from Cancun International Airport.
  • Parking: Complimentary valet and self-parking are available on-site for resort guests.
  • WiFi: Free high-speed Wi-Fi is provided throughout the resort, including guest rooms and all public areas.

2. Moon Palace Cancun

Resort Overview

Moon Palace Cancun is a vast all-inclusive resort divided into three sections: Sunrise, Nizuc, and The Grand. Sunrise and Nizuc form the main Moon Palace Cancun, sharing restaurants, pools, and amenities, while The Grand is a separate luxury resort-within-a-resort. Sunrise is the liveliest, Nizuc is calm and family-friendly, and The Grand offers upscale exclusivity with full access to the rest. All sections are connected via shuttles and walkways. Whether you want high-energy fun, relaxation, or premium luxury, Moon Palace provides a tailored experience for couples, families, and groups—all set on a beautiful beachfront with extensive resort offerings.

Show Full Review

Rooms

Sunrise rooms are comfortable and well-suited for families, offering Swim-Up Suites and connecting Family Suites. Nizuc rooms are slightly larger, with a quieter vibe and the only true oceanfront views in the resort. Both sections share similar decor and amenities, like whirlpool tubs and stocked minibars. The Grand’s rooms are the most spacious and upscale, featuring luxury finishes, premium bedding, and extras like upgraded minibars and private terraces. Guests can choose from lavish suites, Swim-Up options, and Family Suites. Overall, The Grand offers the highest level of in-room comfort and amenities, while Sunrise and Nizuc provide excellent value and convenience.

Amenities

Sunrise is activity-packed, offering the FlowRider surf simulator, an enormous lagoon style pool, a teen lounge, and a kids’ splash zone. Nizuc is more tranquil, with a waterslide-equipped pool and family play areas. Both have Playroom Kids Clubs and easy access to shared amenities like the Awe Spa and 27-hole golf course. The Grand sets itself apart with seven pools, a full water park, a lazy river, an adults-only pool, and more upscale lounges, bowling, and indoor kids’ activities. Grand guests also access all Moon Palace areas, while Sunrise/Nizuc guests cannot enter The Grand without a day pass. Activities cater to all ages.

Dining

Sunrise and Nizuc share 17 restaurants offering global cuisines, from Indian and Italian to Mexican and Brazilian, plus poolside grills and buffets. Sunrise hosts the Noir Nightclub and several bars, making it the main nightlife hub. Nizuc features quieter bars with live music and stylish lounges. The Grand elevates dining with over 10 exclusive gourmet restaurants, including French fine dining, steakhouse, Asian fusion, and more. Grand guests also enjoy all Sunrise/Nizuc dining. Numerous bars, a hidden speakeasy, and a bowling lounge enrich The Grand’s nightlife. We highly suggest making restaurant reservations as soon as you arrive to make sure you get to try all your top choices. Guests can savor authentic Yucatan cuisine at the Riviera Maya restaurant, explore the flavors of India at Agra, or enjoy casual Texas BBQ at Smoked. For popular restaurants like Momo (Asian cuisine), arrive around 4:45 PM to secure a reservation for the hibachi tables, as they fill up quickly.

Details

  • Who This Resort Is Perfect For: Families, couples, and groups wanting all-inclusive luxury, entertainment, and amenities in one beachfront mega-resort.
  • Tripadvisor Rating: 4.5 out of 5, based on 38,000+ reviews for great service, food, and family-friendly facilities.
  • Unique Amenities: FlowRider surf simulator, water park, bowling alley, karaoke lounge, golf course, spa, and exclusive adult and kids’ zones.
  • Swimming Pools: Over 10 pools across all sections, including adults-only, kids’ splash zones, lazy river, and water park slides.
  • Beach Access: Direct beach access with loungers, bars, and water sports. Seaweed may affect swimming depending on season.
  • Can’t Miss For Grown Ups: Noir Nightclub, spa, adult-only pool, fine dining, and the hidden speakeasy at The Grand.
  • Can’t Miss For Kids: Water park, FlowRider, Playroom Kids Club, Wired arcade, and waterslides in Sunrise and The Grand.
  • How Many Restaurants and Bars?: 27+ total. Sunrise/Nizuc share 17; The Grand has 10+ exclusive restaurants and many bars.
  • Are Restaurant Reservations Required?: Yes, for à la carte dining—especially at The Grand. Buffet and casual options are open seating.
  • Gratuities Included: Yes, tips are included, but extra tipping for great service is welcomed and common.
  • Distance To Airport: About 7 miles (11.6 km), 15-minute drive from Cancun International Airport.
  • Parking: Free self-parking available for all guests.
  • WiFi: Free high-speed WiFi throughout the resort, including rooms, pools, and restaurants.

3. Hyatt Ziva Cancun

Resort Overview

Hyatt Ziva Cancun is a luxury all-inclusive resort set on a peninsula in Cancun’s Hotel Zone, surrounded by the Caribbean Sea on three sides and offering panoramic ocean vistas at every turn. This family-friendly oasis features all-suite accommodations with private balconies and stunning ocean views. Guests of all ages enjoy three infinity pools, two white-sand beaches, and activities ranging from a KidZ Club with a splash park to nightly live entertainment – truly something for everyone. The resort also features an exclusive adults-only Turquoize tower, a private haven for guests 18+ seeking added luxury within the property.

Show Full Review

Rooms

All rooms and suites feature elegant furnishings, spa-like bathrooms, and private balconies with ocean or resort views. In-room amenities include daily-stocked minibars, plush bathrobes, and 24-hour room service for convenient all-inclusive indulgence. Families will appreciate the ample space (some two-story suite options) and flexible bedding configurations, while couples can opt for swim-up suites that open directly into a pool from the terrace. Turquoize, the adults-only tower, offers exclusive suites around 700 sq ft each, with private balcony hot tubs and personal butler service for an elevated stay.

Amenities

Hyatt Ziva Cancun boasts three infinity pools and two gorgeous beaches (one on each side of the resort). Families love the KidZ Club’s splash park and daily activities, while teens have their own @Moods lounge to socialize. Included activities range from non-motorized water sports to poolside exercise classes. For relaxation, adults can retreat to the ocean-view Zen Spa (with hydrotherapy circuit) or the modern fitness center. Evenings feature live entertainment at the outdoor amphitheater and other events. Turquoize guests get exclusive use of a rooftop infinity pool and the private Punta Vista sky bar – an adults-only haven with panoramic views.

Dining

Dining is a highlight, with eight restaurants serving diverse cuisines – from a romantic adults-only French brasserie to Asian teppanyaki, Italian trattoria, authentic Mexican eats, and even a retro American diner. Ten bars and lounges keep the drinks flowing, including swim-up pool bars and beachside cantinas. All meals, snacks, and drinks (including top-shelf liquor) are included. Try the teppanyaki at Moongate, indulge in the Chef’s Table Experience, or simply try a beverage at the onsite microbrewery Tres CerveZa’s. Order pizza, lasagna, or steak at Lorenzo’s, but save room for Pasteles, a dessert parlor overflowing with candies and sweets for all ages. Most dining venues operate on a first-come, first-served basis and do not require reservations. However, the teppanyaki tables at Moongate are an exception and do accept reservations. Turquoize guests also enjoy exclusive access to the rooftop Punta Vista sky bar for adults-only cocktails with a view.

Details

  • Who This Resort Is Perfect For: Families, couples, and groups looking for luxury, fun, and all-ages activities in a beachfront setting.
  • Tripadvisor Rating: 4.5 out of 5 stars, based on 14,000+ guest reviews praising service, food, and beach location.
  • Unique Amenities: On-site microbrewery, rooftop infinity pool, candy dessert parlor, teen lounge, KidZ Club, and dolphin lagoon.
  • Swimming Pools: Three infinity pools, including one adults-only rooftop pool in the Turquoize tower.
  • Beach Access: Direct access to two stunning white-sand beaches with calm swimming and beautiful Caribbean views.
  • Can’t Miss For Grown Ups: Rooftop sky bar at Turquoize, Zen Spa, and the craft beer at Tres Cervezas microbrewery.
  • Can’t Miss For Kids: KidZ Club splash park, candy shop, and nightly family shows with music and performers.
  • How Many Restaurants and Bars?: Eight restaurants and ten bars, including swim-up, beach, rooftop, and microbrewery locations.
  • Are Restaurant Reservations Required?: No reservations needed, except for teppanyaki seating at the Asian restaurant.
  • Gratuities Included: Yes, all tips and taxes are included in the all-inclusive package.
  • Distance To Airport: About 30 minutes (23 km) from Cancun International Airport by car or shuttle.
  • Parking: Free on-site self-parking available for all registered guests.

  • WiFi: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the resort, including rooms and public spaces.

4. Haven Riviera Cancun

Resort Overview

Haven Riviera Cancun is an adults-only, all-inclusive beachfront resort located about 15 minutes south of Cancun’s international airport. Set between Cancun and the Riviera Maya, the resort offers a calm, upscale atmosphere ideal for couples and relaxation seekers. With only 435 suites, it delivers an intimate, modern experience with a strong emphasis on personalized service, wellness, and luxury. Guests enjoy stunning ocean views, tranquil tropical surroundings, and a sense of peaceful seclusion. For those desiring even more exclusivity, the Serenity Club offers upgraded amenities like private check-in, personal butlers, and exclusive beach and pool access.

Show Full Review

Rooms

All suites are spacious and elegantly designed, featuring king or double beds, spa-style bathrooms, and private balconies or terraces. Many include outdoor whirlpool tubs or direct swim-out access to heated pools. Thoughtful in-room amenities include aromatherapy and pillow menus, stocked minibars, Nespresso machines, and 24-hour room service. Suites are decorated in modern Mexican style, with ocean, pool, or garden views. The Serenity Club Junior Suite Swim-Out Ocean Front room category is well worth the upgrade for the location alone, but also includes butler service and more. If you have butler service, have them reserve pool loungers for you. The pool gets busy early.

Amenities

The resort offers four pools, including a peaceful infinity pool, a lively main pool with entertainment, and a large beachfront whirlpool tub. Guests can unwind at the full-service MySenses Spa, participate in a variety of fitness classes, or enjoy daily beach and poolside activities. At the spa, try the hydrotherapy circuit and ask about the Temezcal experience, an ancient Mayan sweat lodge ritual. Nightly entertainment includes live music, themed events, and shows at the Moons lounge with live DJ music twice a week. There’s also tennis, a fitness center, and complimentary scuba lessons in the pool. For those seeking adventure, consider trying kayaking or renting a Hobie Cat sailboat. Serenity Club guests enjoy their own private pool, beach area with butler service, complimentary golf, and enhanced room amenities.

Dining

Haven Riviera Cancun features seven restaurants serving Mediterranean, Mexican, Italian, Asian fusion, and international cuisine. Dining options range from romantic fine dining to beachside grills and coffee shops. The resort has nine bars, including swim-up bars, a sports bar, and the Moons nightclub. Premium drinks, cocktails, and wines are all included in the all-inclusive plan. Auga Bendita is a delicious Mexican steakhouse with a sophisticated setting. Satsu offers delightful Asian fusion cuisine where guests can enjoy a show by the chef at a teppanyaki table. Try Limes, the American style bar with stunning views you’ll have to see to believe. The buffet also offers great choices for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Most à la carte venues require reservations, so be sure to make them upon arrival. Serenity Club guests receive access to exclusive dining at Vistas and Tahani, offering private gourmet meals and an oceanfront breakfast experience, adding an additional level of indulgence and quiet luxury to their stay.

Details

  • Who This Resort Is Perfect For: Romantic getaways, couples, honeymooners, and adults seeking peace, luxury, and a modern, tranquil beachfront experience.
  • Tripadvisor Rating: 4.5 out of 5 stars from thousands of reviews praising service, spa, suites, and serene ambiance.
  • Unique Amenities: Swim-up suites, outdoor whirlpools, aromatherapy menus, butler service, hydrotherapy spa, and oceanfront Serenity Club section.

5. Iberostar Selection Cancun

Resort Overview

Iberostar Selection Cancun is a beachfront, all-inclusive resort located in Cancun’s Hotel Zone, just 15 minutes from the airport. It combines a vibrant, family-friendly atmosphere with extensive amenities, including a stunning beach, large pool areas, and a wide range of activities. The resort is known for delivering a balance of relaxation and recreation. It’s perfect for both families and couples, offering fun for all ages within a beautifully maintained property. For adults seeking elevated service and tranquility, the Coral Level provides a separate “resort within a resort” experience, complete with its own amenities and full access to the main resort.

Show Full Review

Rooms

The main resort offers bright, modern rooms with balconies, ocean views, and family-friendly layouts. Options range from standard rooms to beachfront villas and two-bedroom suites. All rooms include free Wi-Fi, stocked minibars, flat-screen TVs, and air conditioning. Some feature whirlpool tubs or direct pool access. Rooms are comfortable and functional, ideal for families or couples. The tropical décor is cheerful, with thoughtful amenities and clean finishes. Coral Level accommodations, located in a separate adults-only tower, feature larger oceanfront junior suites with added luxury like outdoor whirlpools, upgraded tech, and concierge service, available to adults seeking elevated comfort and privacy.

Amenities

Guests enjoy 10 pools, a wide stretch of soft beach, a kids’ splash zone, and a water park. Family activities include Star Camp kids’ club, beach games, tennis, and a FIFA-sized soccer field. Adults can relax in the spa, work out at the fitness center, or golf on the on-site 18-hole course. Daily entertainment and nightly shows create a fun, energetic vibe. There’s also a full schedule of activities, from dance classes to aqua aerobics. Coral Level guests can access all amenities and also enjoy an exclusive infinity pool, private beach area, rooftop spa cabanas, and reserved adult-only spaces.

Dining

The main resort features five restaurants: a large buffet and four à la carte venues—Mexican, Japanese, French, and a steakhouse. There’s also a beachfront snack bar, sports bar, coffee shop, and seven bars throughout the property, including a swim-up and beach bar. Reservations are required for à la carte dinners. Try the La Parrilla Steakhouse for the best cuts of meat grilled to perfection. Trattoria La Horma offers delicious Italian cuisine from beef carpaccio to wood-fired pizzas and a variety of pasta dishes. Teppanyaki Naga Hibachi has delicious Japanese fare, including sushi and meats grilled right in front of you! Coral Level guests enjoy their own oceanview restaurant, snack bar and pool bars, along with access to all main resort dining and drinking venues.

Details

  • Who This Resort Is Perfect For: Families, couples, and adults seeking a mix of fun, relaxation, and luxury in a beachfront all-inclusive setting.
  • Tripadvisor Rating: 4.5 out of 5, praised for beach, service, food, and Coral Level’s premium, adults-only experience.
  • Unique Amenities: On-site golf course, kids’ water park, rooftop spa treatments, and FIFA-sized soccer field.
  • Swimming Pools: Ten total, including splash zones, activity pool, quiet pools for lounging, and Coral’s adults-only infinity pool.
  • Beach Access: Direct access to a wide white-sand beach with loungers, umbrellas, and Coral Level’s private service area.
  • Can’t Miss For Grown Ups: Rooftop spa massages, infinity pool, gourmet dining at La Horma and Coral Level’s oceanfront hot tub suites.
  • Can’t Miss For Kids: Water park with giant shark slide, Star Camp activities, kids’ pool, and family-friendly evening shows.
  • How Many Restaurants and Bars?: 5 restaurants and 7 bars main resort; Coral Level adds 1 restaurant and 2 bars.
  • Are Restaurant Reservations Required?: Yes, required for à la carte dinners; buffet and Coral Level restaurant do not require reservations.
  • Gratuities Included: Yes, tips are included, though extra tipping for great service is welcome.
  • Distance To Airport: About 15–20 minutes (11 miles) from Cancun International Airport; quick, easy resort transfer.
  • Parking: Free on-site self-parking available for all guests; valet parking also offered without charge.
  • WiFi: Free high-speed WiFi throughout rooms and public areas; strong, unlimited device access across the property.

6. Live Aqua Beach Resort

Resort Overview

Live Aqua Beach Resort Cancun is an upscale adults-only, all-inclusive retreat on a stunning white sand beach in Cancun’s Hotel Zone. This AAA Four Diamond property is known for its tranquil, sensory-focused atmosphere, featuring aromatherapy, ambient music, and elegant design. The resort’s vibe is peaceful and refined—perfect for couples seeking a serene escape. Guests enjoy multiple pools, attentive service, and a luxury spa, all surrounded by beautiful Caribbean views. For an added layer of exclusivity, Aqua Club guests receive upgraded services including a private lounge, concierge check-in, and personal butler service in an elevated adults-only setting.

Show Full Review

Rooms

The resort offers 371 rooms and suites, all featuring modern décor, private balconies, and luxurious touches like Egyptian cotton linens, aromatherapy menus, and spa-style bathrooms. Many rooms offer panoramic ocean views, and some include soaking tubs with open shutters for a bath-with-a-view experience. Smart TVs, high-speed Wi-Fi, stocked minibars, and comfortable furnishings ensure a restful stay. The soft lighting and relaxing scents create a personalized, spa-like ambiance. Aqua Club rooms, located on the top floors, include extra perks like access to the private club lounge, butler service, upgraded amenities, and sweeping views of the sea.

Amenities

Live Aqua features seven outdoor pools, including an infinity pool with a swim-up bar, plus a sprawling white sand beach with cabanas, Bali beds and loungers. Guests enjoy beachside drink service, a modern gym, yoga classes, water aerobics, and daily activities including dance classes and culinary sessions to enrich your stay. The Feel Harmony Spa offers a full hydrotherapy circuit and holistic treatments, perfect for deep relaxation. Evenings bring live music, DJs, and stylish lounges. For those wanting quiet and exclusivity, Aqua Club members have access to a private beach area, their own reserved poolside seating, and perks like complimentary foot massages and priority service throughout the resort.

Dining

The resort offers seven restaurants with varied cuisines: Mexican, Italian, Asian fusion, Mediterranean, and gourmet fine dining. If you like seafood, Sea Corner is the place to go, while Azure has Latin American dishes. If you want something lighter, Cafe Deli Boutique is a good option. Hidden Garden is a very popular Asian Fusion restaurant in a lovely garden setting. Guests also enjoy a sushi station, deli café, and 24-hour room service. Five bars offer craft cocktails, premium liquors, and ocean views—don’t miss the swim-up bar or the Egos Lounge for late-night drinks and dancing. Aqua Club guests enjoy access to a private lounge offering daily breakfast, gourmet snacks, afternoon tea, and top-shelf spirits in a relaxed, elegant setting.

Details

7. Excellence Playa Mujeres

Resort Overview

Often referred to as “the Jewel of Cancun,” Excellence Playa Mujeres is a luxury adults-only, all-inclusive resort located in a private, gated community just north of Cancun. Set along a quiet two-mile stretch of white sand beach, the resort offers a peaceful and romantic atmosphere ideal for couples and honeymooners. Guests enjoy lush tropical gardens, elegant architecture, and a secluded beachfront with stunning views of the Caribbean Sea. The resort is known for its attentive service, generous all-inclusive offerings, and spacious layout. For those looking to elevate their stay, the Excellence Club provides exclusive access to private areas, premium amenities, and personalized concierge service.

Show Full Review

Rooms

The resort features 450 spacious suites designed with romantic luxury in mind. Standard rooms include a four-poster king bed, a large whirlpool tub, private balcony or terrace, and marble bathrooms with dual rainfall showers. Amenities include 24-hour room service, fully stocked minibar, free Wi-Fi, and turndown service. Swim-up suites and rooftop terrace suites with plunge pools are available for guests seeking extra indulgence. Elegant finishes, thoughtful details, and tropical views create a tranquil environment. Excellence Club suites add perks like fresh flowers, premium liquor selection and upgraded room locations.

Amenities

Excellence Playa Mujeres offers seven outdoor pools, including swim-up and quiet pool options. Guests can relax on a private beach with soft sand, shaded loungers, and drink service. Activities include non-motorized water sports, tennis, yoga, and bike tours, while the 24-hour fitness center keeps guests active. The world-class Miilé Spa features a full hydrotherapy circuit, indoor and beachfront treatment rooms, and a wide selection of therapies. Evening entertainment includes live music, shows, and beach events. Excellence Club guests enjoy additional pools, a private beach section with concierge service, and priority access to spa and dining reservations.

Dining

Dining is a standout with 10 diverse restaurants offering Mexican, Italian, Asian, French, Indian, steakhouse, and seafood cuisine. Most restaurants are à la carte, and no reservations are required. You can try Asian food at Spice, enjoy elegant French-inspired cuisine at Chez Isabelle, or sample small plates from all over the world at Flavor Market, among others. Healthy and vegetarian options are available at all venues, and 24-hour room service is included. Guests can also enjoy 11 bars, including swim-up bars, beach bars, a martini bar, a sports bar, and poolside lounges. Premium drinks and cocktails are available throughout the resort. Excellence Club guests receive access to Magna, a private gourmet restaurant, and the Cielo lounge for exclusive drinks, snacks, and a quieter ambiance.

Details

  • How Many Restaurants and Bars?: Ten restaurants and eleven bars, including swim-up bars and exclusive venues for Excellence Club members.
  • Are Restaurant Reservations Required?: No reservations needed; all à la carte restaurants are first-come, first-served.
  • Gratuities Included: Yes, tips and taxes are included; additional tipping is optional and appreciated.
  • Distance To Airport: About 25 minutes by car from Cancun International Airport.
  • Parking: Free on-site parking and valet service available to all guests.

Like their sister resort in Cabo San Lucas, Secrets The Vine is known for above par service and amenities. The resort offers “Unlimited-Luxury,” which includes gourmet dining, premium drinks, 24-hour room service, pool and beach waiter service, and all taxes and gratuities. Guests can unwind by the infinity pools or on the white sand beach, enjoy water sports, or join daily activities and evening entertainment. A signature wine theme is woven throughout the property, with tastings led by sommeliers. Preferred Club guests enjoy upgraded services like private check-in, lounge access, and VIP amenities.

Rooms

The resort features 497 stylish rooms and suites with Italian porcelain floors, teak furnishings, spa-like bathrooms, and private balconies with ocean or lagoon views. Rooms include a daily refreshed minibar, Nespresso machine, free Wi-Fi, and 24-hour room service. Floor-to-ceiling windows provide plenty of natural light and impressive vistas. Some suites feature soaking tubs and larger living areas. All accommodations are thoughtfully designed for modern comfort with a romantic, upscale feel. Preferred Club rooms offer added perks like premium minibar selections, pillow menus and personalized butler service.

9. Paradisus Cancun

Resort Overview

Update: Paradisus Cancun is temporarily closed for renovations and will not reopen until April 2026. Booking for 2026 is currently open.

Paradisus Cancun is a luxurious all-inclusive resort located in Cancun’s Hotel Zone, nestled between the Nichupté Lagoon and the Caribbean Sea. Famous for its striking five-pyramid architecture and lush indoor gardens, the resort offers a balance of elegance, energy, and relaxation. With a beautiful white sand beach, expansive pools, and daily entertainment, it appeals to families, couples, and groups alike. The atmosphere blends tropical sophistication with family-friendly fun and adult-focused refinement. Guests looking for a more upscale experience can upgrade to The Reserve, an exclusive section within the resort that includes upgraded suites, services, and amenities, including private check-in, dedicated concierge service, and access to adults-only lounges, pools, and dining areas.

Show Full Review

Rooms

Guest rooms and suites at Paradisus Cancun feature contemporary décor, marble finishes, and private balconies with lagoon or ocean views. All rooms include rainfall showers, stocked minibars, satellite TV, and 24-hour room service. Junior suites and family suites offer spacious comfort for all types of travelers. For a more refined stay, The Reserve accommodations come with luxury upgrades such as personalized pillow menus, turndown service, high-end bath products, butler service and oceanfront views.

Amenities

The resort offers four outdoor pools, including a swim-up bar and a kids splash zone area. The full-service YHI Spa provides massages, facials, and hydrotherapy. Guests can enjoy a 9-hole par-3 golf course with complimentary green fees, tennis courts, yoga classes, and non-motorized water sports. Families will appreciate the Kids Zone for ages 5–12 and the Baby Zone for toddlers. Daily and nightly entertainment ensures there’s always something happening. The Reserve guests benefit from exclusive access to a private pool, beachfront cabanas, a VIP lounge, and concierge assistance for spa, golf, and dining reservations.

Dining

With nine restaurants and seven bars, Paradisus Cancun offers an exceptional dining experience. Cuisine options include gourmet Mexican, Pan-Asian, Mediterranean, and international buffets. Try the Malvar Food Bazaar for international cuisine options or dine on traditional Mexican cuisine at Mole. The lively Blue Agave bar serves tequila and mezcal, while the Red Lounge offers evening cocktails and music. There’s also a beach grill, sushi bar, and a coffee shop for quick bites. No reservations are required at most restaurants, though they are recommended for dinner. Guests staying in The Reserve enjoy exclusive dining at La Palapa, a beachfront restaurant offering a more private and elevated culinary experience with premium service and ocean views.

Show Full Review

Rooms

Wyndham Alltra Cancun offers 458 spacious rooms and suites, decorated in bright, contemporary tones with tropical flair. All rooms feature private balconies or terraces, many with stunning ocean views. Standard amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and daily restocked minibars. Family Junior Suites comfortably accommodate families with bunk beds and a trundle, along with a king-sized bed for adults. Adults seeking more privacy can select oceanfront swim-up suites, featuring semi-private infinity pools, exclusive VIP lounge access, and luxury amenities. The diverse accommodations ensure comfort for all guests, from families needing spaciousness to couples desiring romantic, adults-only retreats.

Amenities

The resort offers outstanding amenities catering to guests of all ages. Multiple pools include a spacious beachfront pool and an exciting pirate-themed splash park complete with waterslides and interactive water features. The supervised Camp Alltra kids’ club keeps children entertained with creative activities and games, while teens enjoy their own dedicated #Hashtag lounge with video games and social spaces. Adults can unwind at the Aura Spa, featuring rejuvenating treatments and hydrotherapy circuits, or relax in private beachfront cabanas. The resort also hosts daily fitness classes, nightly entertainment, and provides convenient beachside waiter service, ensuring comfort and fun for everyone. From August to November, the resort also features a turtle release program, during which over 10,000 eggs are hatched.

Dining

Guests savor diverse dining experiences across eight restaurants, ranging from international buffets at Ventanas to authentic Mexican cuisine at Casa de Rosa and Italian classics at Viaggio. Azul offers casual beachfront dining by day and Asian specialties at night. Quick bites are found at the Brasas poolside grill, while Cravings dessert parlor and Café México offer treats around-the-clock. Four lively bars serve tropical cocktails, premium liquors, and soft drinks, including poolside and beach bars. The resort maintains a casual dining atmosphere, allowing guests freedom without reservation stress. Room service availability further enhances convenience, providing delightful in-room dining anytime.

Details

  • Who This Resort Is Perfect For: Families seeking beachfront fun, kid-friendly amenities, and activities alongside relaxing options for adults.
  • Tripadvisor Rating: 4.0 out of 5 stars, praised for family-friendly amenities, beachfront location, and attentive staff.
  • Unique Amenities: Pirate-themed water park, dedicated kids’ and teens’ clubs, adults-only swim-up suites, and oceanfront spa facilities.
  • Swimming Pools: Several pools, including a large beachfront pool, kids’ splash park, and exclusive adults-only relaxation area.
  • Beach Access: Direct access to a beautiful, spacious white-sand beach with loungers, umbrellas, and cabana service available.
  • Can’t Miss For Grown Ups: Luxurious Aura Spa treatments, beachfront yoga classes, and relaxation at adults-only swim-up suites.
  • Can’t Miss For Kids: Exciting pirate-themed splash park, supervised kids’ club activities, and interactive teen lounge with gaming and social events.
  • How Many Restaurants and Bars?: Eight restaurants and four bars, offering international cuisine, casual dining, premium drinks, and delicious treats.
  • Are Restaurant Reservations Required?: No reservations required; dining is first-come, first-served with waiting lists during peak times.
  • Gratuities Included: Yes, gratuities and taxes included; no tipping necessary, though appreciated for exceptional service.
  • Distance To Airport: Approximately 25-minute drive (13 miles) from Cancun International Airport (CUN).
  • Parking: No dedicated resort parking available; guests utilize nearby public street parking.
  • WiFi: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi available throughout the resort, including rooms, common areas, and poolside.

13. Hyatt Zilara Cancun

Resort Overview

Update: Hyatt Zilara Cancun is temporarily closed for renovations and will not reopen until “early 2026”. Booking for 2026 is currently open.

Hyatt Zilara Cancun is an upscale adults-only, all-inclusive resort set on a pristine white-sand beach in Cancun’s Hotel Zone. The resort’s atmosphere blends romance and relaxation with elegant Mexican hacienda-inspired architecture featuring wrought-iron details, stained-glass accents, and expansive ocean-view spaces. Known for personalized service, the resort provides beach butlers, romance concierge, and thoughtful attention to detail. Guests unwind at the beachfront infinity pool or enjoy soothing spa treatments by the sea. Nightly entertainment and luxurious amenities create a sophisticated yet lively setting, making this the perfect destination for romantic getaways, honeymoons, or simply a relaxing adults-only vacation.

Show Full Review

Rooms

Hyatt Zilara Cancun offers 310 spacious suites, each featuring ocean or pool views from private balconies or terraces. Suites are elegantly designed with a modern-meets-hacienda style, showcasing whitewashed walls, rustic wood furniture, and wrought-iron accents. Every suite includes a luxurious double whirlpool tub, plush bedding, pillow menus, and spa-inspired bathrooms with rainfall showers and premium amenities. Hammocks and comfortable seating on balconies further enhance relaxation. Accommodations blend romantic charm and upscale comfort, providing an intimate atmosphere. Attention to detail, sophisticated decor, and breathtaking Caribbean views create a peaceful, luxurious retreat perfect for adults seeking tranquility and romance.

Amenities

Guests enjoy extensive amenities designed for relaxation and indulgence. The spectacular beachfront infinity pool, complete with swim-up bar and submerged loungers, is the centerpiece of relaxation. Additionally, an Olympic-size lap pool and oceanfront hot tubs offer varied experiences. The expansive Zen Spa includes a comprehensive hydrotherapy circuit, oceanfront massage gazebos, and traditional Mayan Temazcal sauna. Fitness enthusiasts appreciate the rooftop Sky Gym with daily classes such as yoga. Nightly entertainment ranges from mariachi bands to acrobatic performances. Beach cabanas, attentive poolside service, and personalized concierge further elevate the luxury experience, creating an ideal setting for unwinding and recharging.

Dining

Hyatt Zilara Cancun offers a diverse culinary experience with six gourmet restaurants. Asiana presents contemporary Asian cuisine, including sushi and teppanyaki prepared live. Maria Marie serves upscale Mexican dishes in an elegant setting. Cantina La Adelita offers traditional Mexican fare with a selection of craft beers. Punta Vista provides Caribbean fusion cuisine with ocean views. Spice features an international buffet with live cooking stations. Chef’s Plate offers an exclusive multi-course tasting menu, available by reservation. Complementing the dining are five bars, including a beachfront tequila bar and a lobby lounge with live music. Room service is available 24/7.​

Details

  • Who This Resort Is Perfect For: Couples and honeymooners seeking an intimate, luxurious adults-only beachfront retreat with exceptional service and amenities.
  • Tripadvisor Rating: Rated 4.5 out of 5 stars, consistently praised for romantic ambiance, excellent dining, attentive service, and beachfront setting.
  • Unique Amenities: Infinity pool with swim-up bar, in-suite double whirlpool tubs, extensive spa with hydrotherapy circuit, rooftop fitness center.
  • Swimming Pools: Two pools including a beachfront infinity pool with swim-up bar and an Olympic-size lap pool, plus oceanfront hot tubs.
  • Beach Access: Direct access to one of Cancun’s widest, pristine white-sand beaches, including beach butler service and private cabanas.
  • Can’t Miss For Grown Ups: Beachfront couples’ massage at Zen Spa, romantic private dining on the beach, and nightly live entertainment shows.
  • Can’t Miss For Kids: Not applicable – resort is adults-only (18+) with no children allowed.
  • How Many Restaurants and Bars?: Six gourmet restaurants and five bars, including swim-up and beachfront options offering premium drinks and gourmet cuisine.
  • Are Restaurant Reservations Required?: Reservations only needed for Chef’s Plate and Asiana’s teppanyaki; other restaurants are walk-in friendly.
  • Gratuities Included: Yes, gratuities and taxes are fully included in the resort’s all-inclusive package; additional tipping is optional.
  • Distance To Airport: Approximately 20-minute drive (13 miles) from Cancun International Airport (CUN).
  • Parking: Complimentary self-parking and valet parking services available on-site for guests.
  • WiFi: Free high-speed Wi-Fi available throughout the resort, including rooms, pools, restaurants, bars, and public areas.

14. Fiesta Americana Condesa

Resort Overview

Fiesta Americana Condesa Cancun is a family-friendly, all-inclusive resort located on a beautiful white sand beach in Cancun’s vibrant Hotel Zone. The resort is celebrated for its lively, Mexican-inspired ambiance, highlighted by a stunning 40-meter palapa lobby that warmly welcomes guests. Its upbeat yet relaxing atmosphere appeals equally to families, couples, and adult groups. Daily entertainment includes activities for all ages, from kids’ clubs to tequila tastings and live music. The resort also provides quiet adult-only areas, balancing energetic family activities with tranquility for grown-ups. Friendly, attentive service ensures every guest feels welcome and well-cared-for, creating lasting vacation memories.

Show Full Review

Rooms

The resort offers 507 modern rooms and suites recently updated with contemporary Mexican décor, featuring regional artwork, conchuela stone accents, and vibrant colors. Each room includes comfortable amenities such as plush bedding, 55-inch smart TVs, minibars, rainfall showers, and private balconies or terraces—many with spectacular ocean or lagoon views. Spacious suites add extra comfort, with Master Suites offering panoramic ocean views and the luxurious Presidential Suite featuring an expansive terrace and private Jacuzzi. All rooms and suites are non-smoking and equipped with complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, ensuring comfort and convenience whether traveling as a family, couple, or solo adult.

Amenities

Amenities at Fiesta Americana Condesa Cancun cater to guests of all ages. Two expansive freeform pools feature cascading levels, swim-up bars, and designated shallow areas ideal for children. Young guests enjoy the Fiesta Kids Club (ages 4–12) and Teens Club, both offering engaging supervised activities. Adults seeking relaxation can indulge in rejuvenating treatments at Miiluma Spa, featuring hydrotherapy pools, beachfront massage cabanas, and a soothing sauna. Daily activities include beach volleyball, cooking classes, and yoga sessions. Evenings come alive with family-friendly shows, live music, and cultural experiences like tequila tastings, ensuring entertainment and relaxation for every member of the family.

Dining

The resort’s dining options span eleven restaurants and six bars, showcasing diverse international cuisines. Highlights include El Mexicano, serving gourmet Mexican dishes, Rosato for refined Italian dining, and Kalmia, offering extensive international buffet selections. Casual beachside grills and snack stations offer pizza, burgers, and ice cream—perfect for families. Adults appreciate the elegant lobby bar for nightly live music and expertly crafted cocktails beneath the grand palapa roof. Reservations are required for specialty restaurants, easily booked via the resort’s app. The variety of dining experiences, from casual to sophisticated, ensures every guest enjoys memorable meals throughout their stay.

Details

  • Who This Resort Is Perfect For: Families, couples, and groups seeking an upbeat, culturally inspired all-inclusive resort with amenities catering to all ages.
  • Tripadvisor Rating: 4.5 out of 5 stars, highly praised for exceptional family amenities, lively atmosphere, and attentive, friendly service.
  • Unique Amenities: Impressive 40-meter palapa lobby, authentic cultural activities like cooking classes, tequila tastings, and beachfront massage cabanas.
  • Swimming Pools: Two large cascading freeform pools with swim-up bars, hot tubs, and designated shallow areas perfect for young children.
  • Beach Access: Direct access to a wide, pristine white sand beach with clear, calm water ideal for swimming and relaxing.
  • Can’t Miss For Grown Ups: Luxurious hydrotherapy experiences at Miiluma Spa and tequila tasting evenings accompanied by live music in the lobby bar.
  • Can’t Miss For Kids: Fiesta Kids Club offering engaging supervised activities, plus poolside snack stations featuring pizza, burgers, and ice cream.
  • How Many Restaurants and Bars?: Eleven restaurants and six bars, ranging from casual snack bars to upscale international specialty dining experiences.
  • Are Restaurant Reservations Required?: Reservations required for specialty à la carte restaurants (via resort app); buffet and snack venues available without reservations.
  • Gratuities Included: Yes, all gratuities and taxes are included in the resort’s comprehensive all-inclusive package; additional tipping is optional.
  • Distance To Airport: Approximately 20 minutes (15 miles) by car from Cancun International Airport (CUN).
  • Parking: Complimentary 24-hour self-parking is provided on-site for all resort guests.
  • WiFi: Free high-speed Wi-Fi is accessible throughout the resort, including guest rooms, common areas, pools, and beach areas.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does an all-inclusive resort in Cancun cost per night?

Most Cancun all-inclusive resorts range from $250 to $800 USD per night for two adults, depending on the resort tier and season. Budget-friendly options like Wyndham Alltra start closer to $250 USD, while luxury properties like Le Blanc can exceed $700 USD. Booking during May or early June often gets you the lowest rates. Our guide above breaks down the best resorts at every price level.

What is the best time of year to visit Cancun for an all-inclusive vacation?

December through April offers the best weather, with warm temperatures and minimal rain. This is peak season, so expect higher prices and larger crowds. For the best balance of good weather and lower rates, consider late April or early May, just before the rainy season begins. We cover seasonal considerations for each resort in the full guide above.

What is typically included at Cancun all-inclusive resorts?

Your rate covers your room, all meals at on-site restaurants, unlimited drinks (alcoholic and non-alcoholic), pools, beach access, daily activities, entertainment, and WiFi. Most resorts also include a kids’ club and fitness center. Spa treatments, excursions, and premium dining upgrades usually cost extra. The resort reviews above detail exactly what each property includes.

Do you still need to tip at Cancun all-inclusive resorts?

Yes, tipping is customary even when gratuities are included in your rate. Most guests tip $1 to $5 USD per service for bartenders, housekeeping, and restaurant servers. You can tip in either US dollars or Mexican pesos. From our experience, staff genuinely appreciate the gesture since included gratuities don’t always reach them directly. Our full resort reviews above note each property’s gratuity policy.

What is the best area to stay in Cancun for an all-inclusive resort?

The Hotel Zone is the most popular area, putting you close to nightlife, shopping, and beaches like Playa Delfines. Playa Mujeres is quieter and more upscale, ideal for couples. Riviera Cancun (south of the Hotel Zone) offers seclusion and luxury golf courses. Each area suits a different travel style. We break down all four Cancun neighborhoods in the guide above.

Is Cancun or the Riviera Maya better for an all-inclusive vacation?

Cancun is better if you want nightlife, shopping, and a lively atmosphere with dozens of resort options in the Hotel Zone alone. The Riviera Maya (Playa del Carmen, Tulum, Akumal) is better for a quieter, more nature-focused trip with cenotes and ruins nearby. Cancun’s airport is also closer to Hotel Zone resorts, just 20 to 30 minutes away. Our guide above covers all the top Cancun options to help you decide.

What are the best adults-only all-inclusive resorts in Cancun?

Excellence Playa Mujeres and Le Blanc Spa Resort both hold perfect 5.0 out of 5 TripAdvisor ratings, making them the top-rated adults-only options. Haven Riviera Cancun, Secrets The Vine, and Live Aqua are also excellent choices. For newer properties, Hyatt Vivid Grand Island opened in 2024 with a lively, upscale vibe. We review each of these resorts in detail in the guide above.

What are the best family-friendly all-inclusive resorts in Cancun?

Grand Fiesta Americana Coral Beach stands out with its 40,000-square-foot Coral KidZ Club, waterslides, and a calm swimming beach. Moon Palace is another top pick, featuring a FlowRider surf simulator, go-karts, and a massive pool complex across three resort sections. Hyatt Ziva and Iberostar Selection are also strong family choices. Our full guide above reviews each family resort’s kid-specific amenities.

Is sargassum seaweed a problem at Cancun all-inclusive resorts?

Sargassum typically arrives on Cancun’s Caribbean coast between April and August, though the severity varies each year. Most high-end resorts rake their beaches daily and use floating barriers to keep the sand clean. Grand Fiesta Americana, for example, is frequently praised for keeping its beach clear. Resorts in Playa Mujeres and the northern Hotel Zone tend to see less seaweed. We note beach conditions for each resort in the guide above.

Can you use US dollars at Cancun all-inclusive resorts?

Yes, US dollars are widely accepted at all-inclusive resorts, restaurants, and shops throughout Cancun’s tourist areas. However, you will typically receive change in Mexican pesos. For tipping, small US bills ($1 and $5) are perfectly fine. At an all-inclusive, you rarely need cash during your stay since meals and drinks are covered. Our resort reviews above note what each property charges beyond the all-inclusive rate.

How far in advance should you book a Cancun all-inclusive resort?

For the best selection and rates, book 3 to 6 months ahead, especially for peak season travel between December and April. Holiday weeks like Christmas and Spring Break can sell out the top resorts 6 to 9 months early. Booking early also gives you the best room categories and any early-bird discounts. We include direct price-check links for every resort in the guide above.

What is the dress code at Cancun all-inclusive resort restaurants?

Buffet and casual restaurants allow shorts, sandals, and swimsuit cover-ups during the day. For evening specialty restaurants, most resorts require resort casual: collared shirts and closed-toe shoes for men, and no swimwear or tank tops for anyone. A few upscale resorts like Le Blanc and Grand Fiesta Americana enforce stricter dress codes at their fine dining venues. Our full resort reviews above detail each property’s dining options and policies.
